transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came because I can’t stop feeling like everything is my fault. I keep telling my family I’m the reason my friend died, because I didn’t call her back… and sometimes I had ugly thoughts, and I feel like the Lord is punishing everybody at church because of me. It just feels true, and I can’t get away from it.
Do these thoughts feel like unwanted thoughts that you know might not be true, or are you certain they are true?

I’m certain. I know it sounds strange, but when the pastor says the prayers, or when the choir sings certain lines, I know they’re really warning me. It feels like God has marked me, and the church is suffering because I brought this on us.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I... I don't know how to measure it. I just know I feel low a lot, and it’s hard to get away from. Most days feel heavy.
Have there been times when you were not feeling depressed but still felt sure that God was punishing people because of you?
No... not before this. Before my friend died, I never thought the pastor or the choir were sending warnings meant for me. Those thoughts only started after I got so low and guilty these past weeks.
Before this recent period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had hard times before, like anyone, but I don’t know that I was depressed nearly every day for two weeks like this. I can’t say for certain.
Have you heard a voice speaking to you when no one else was there?
I don’t think so. I haven’t heard a voice talking to me when nobody was there.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yes. I used to love going to choir, my knitting circle, bingo… even just walking through Patterson Park. Now I mostly just sit in my chair. None of it feels worth getting dressed for anymore.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed if I’m moving or talking slower. I just know I don’t feel like doing much.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?
Yes. I’m tired all the time. Even just standing at the register or carrying a small bag of groceries feels like my bones are full of wet sand. Resting doesn’t seem to help much.
Have you been having thoughts that you would be better off dead or of harming yourself?
I... I don’t really know how to answer that. I haven’t thought it through like that. I just know I feel worn down and I don’t feel like myself.
Are you thinking about killing yourself?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve made up my mind to do that. I just feel really worn out and I don’t know what to do with myself sometimes.
Has there ever been a time when you were having these kinds of beliefs or messages meant for you for at least two weeks while you were not feeling depressed?
No. Before my friend died and before I got this low, I didn’t think the choir or the pastor were sending warnings about me. That only started after I got so depressed and guilty these past weeks.
Before this recent period, was there ever another time in your life when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember having a stretch like this before, not for that long. I’ve had bad days, sure, but I can’t think of another time when it was nearly every day for two weeks.
Before these past weeks, was there ever another time in your life when you felt this depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t think so. I’ve had sad times before, but not like this, not nearly every day for two weeks that I can remember.
